report.incident_title: Contacts marked UNREACHABLE without their phones ever ringing
report.summary: Confirmed by tool data: the carrier's own CDR summary (E7) reports 71% of INVITE attempts rejected with 429 while peak concurrency was 24 against an 80-channel contract, so this is not a concurrent-channel limit. The carrier's support email (E8) says the trunk exceeded its 15 call-attempts/second rate and that excess INVITEs were rejected with 429 from about 05:00 UTC on 2026-03-10. A trace (E12, E13) shows a 429 from the carrier-trunk span propagating through sip-gateway to the dialer. The change history (E16, E17) shows only the K-2214 campaign start at 2026-03-10T04:00Z, and no infra events (E18) or alerts (E4, E15) were recorded. Not confirmed: the dialer step that turns repeated 429s into an UNREACHABLE disposition is unverified, since only two retry log lines for one contact were found (E3) and no disposition logs were searched. The onset date conflicts: the report and H1 say 2026-03-11, while the carrier CDR, vendor email and dialer logs say 2026-03-10 (E9). Sip-gateway and carrier-trunk metrics, traces for K-2214 contacts and the 'vendor status' report were unavailable, so channel-capacity exhaustion (H2) is refuted only indirectly.
report.root_cause: The K-2214 campaign start at 2026-03-10T04:00Z raised INVITE attempt volume on the carrier trunk above the carrier's enforced limit of 15 call attempts/second (all INVITEs counted, including retries). The carrier rejected the excess INVITEs with SIP 429 from about 05:00Z (E7, E8), and sip-gateway passed those errors back to the dialer (E12, E13). The step that marked contacts UNREACHABLE without a call reaching the phone is not yet confirmed (E3, H3 inconclusive), and the onset date should be re-checked against the 2026-03-11 report date (E9).

hypotheses.statement: The carrier applied a per-call-attempt rate limit of 15 attempts/sec on the trunk, causing excess INVITEs to be rejected with SIP 429 Too Many Requests from about 05:00 UTC on 2026-03-10, which propagated through sip-gateway to the dialer and prevented calls from being placed.

facts.text: carrier_cdr_summary_2026-03-10 (generated 2026-03-11T03:00Z) states: contracted concurrent channels 80; peak concurrent channels 24; INVITE attempts rejected (429): 71%. Peak concurrency was well under the contracted limit, so the rejections are not a concurrent-channel capacity limit.

carrier_support_reply (vendor email, generated 2026-03-11T04:30Z): the trunk exceeded its call-attempt rate of 15 attempts/second (all INVITEs counted) for most of 10 March from about 05:00 UTC; excess INVITEs were rejected with 429. The vendor asks us to reduce the attempt rate. This is a carrier-side rate limit on attempts, not a carrier outage.

Only trace in window t-inc013-reject-1 (2026-03-10T07:00:00Z, status error): dialer placeCall for contact CT-60311 attempt 2 errored; sip-gateway 'outbound INVITE' errored with sip_status 429; carrier-trunk INVITE errored with '429 Too Many Requests'. This shows the carrier returning 429 rate-limit responses that propagate back through sip-gateway to the dialer.

The 429 in t-inc013-reject-1 came from the carrier (carrier-trunk span), not a local sip-gateway capacity error; it occurred at 2026-03-10T07:00Z, about 27 hours before the reported 2026-03-11T05:00Z collapse. Also, the trace does not show whether the dialer set UNREACHABLE after this error.

corrective_actions.action: Throttle the campaign dispatch rate, including retries, to a verified margin below 15 INVITEs/second on the carrier trunk, or pause K-2214 until that is confirmed. Do not change carrier or gateway limits to get around the 429s.
corrective_actions.rationale: The carrier's enforced rate limit is the confirmed cause of the rejections, and the campaign scheduler dispatches at 12 calls/sec (E10). Retries may push total attempts over 15/sec; that is an assumption to verify against CDR attempt-rate data.

corrective_actions.action: Identify contacts from K-2214 marked UNREACHABLE after 429 rejections and re-queue them for call attempts once the rate is under the limit. Do not reclassify them without checking their disposition history.
corrective_actions.rationale: Contacts were marked UNREACHABLE without their phones ringing, so their status is wrong. The affected population is not yet counted (no disposition logs were pulled).

corrective_actions.action: Change the dialer so that 429 and other carrier rate-limit responses are retried with backoff and do not set a final UNREACHABLE disposition until retries are exhausted and the reason is recorded.
corrective_actions.rationale: The dialer retried one contact correctly (E3), but whether repeated 429s end in UNREACHABLE is unverified. This change is only justified if the disposition logs confirm the mapping.

corrective_actions.action: Add an enforced rate limiter ahead of the carrier trunk, set below the carrier's 15 attempts/second limit with margin, and have campaign-scheduler respect it.
corrective_actions.rationale: Nothing in the topology or change history enforces the carrier's attempt rate (E10, E16), so a campaign can exceed it silently.

corrective_actions.action: Alert on carrier 429 rate, the UNREACHABLE disposition rate per campaign, and connect rate drops, and make sure sip-gateway, carrier-trunk and dialer metrics are actually collected.
corrective_actions.rationale: No alert fired for the 429 pattern or the connect-rate collapse, and every metrics query returned empty (E4, E15, E1, E14).

corrective_actions.action: Fix trace sampling for campaign traffic and verify that the change and infra event sources cover the full window.
corrective_actions.rationale: Only one trace exists in the window (E11), and the change query returned a single point (E19), so the absence of other evidence is weak.
